scope: Controlled copied-Game comparisons with the same actual 5-SP research purchases in a labelled 27-SP Endless lobby. Each pair walks the same original greater-than-112px narrow route, optionally walks up to 48px along the original shield bearing, waits the same 13 combat ticks and meets one injected hostile projectile from a newly exposed bearing. When a wide sideways setdown is physically blocked, the pivot arm must actually reject Action 1, retain the narrow shield, wait its unchanged 60-tick recovery and turn back before legal full-width setdown. The fixed arm waits the same original recovery schedule. All moves use ordinary inputs and original collision. Boss stagger isolates interception. Original health, first expiry, Q recovery and panel identity remain. Original blocked endpoints and every candidate failure remain. No natural, canonical, online or balance claim.
